title: find_cert: ias.issuer.to_der() called inside loop (N allocs per signer)
description: In verify.rs find_cert(), for the IssuerAndSerialNumber case, ias.issuer.to_der() is called inside the .find() closure — once per certificate in the bag. The issuer DER is constant for a given SID; it should be hoisted outside the closure. Expected impact: small for typical cert bags (5-20 certs), but avoids repeated allocations during verification.
